usage: Save as extract_fields.py after operator review. Requires Python 3 and no dependencies. Run: python3 extract_fields.py < input.json. Supply one object containing text and fields, not the training wrapper. Alternatively, import extract_fields and call extract_fields(payload). Example input: {"text":"id: item-123\nname: Zoë","fields":["id","name","note"]}. Output: {"fields":{"id":"item-123","name":"Zoë"}}. Matching is case-sensitive with no label whitespace normalization. Values are trimmed; additional colons remain in values. Lines without a colon (including a bare 'id') are ignored. These whitespace and malformed-line conventions are explicit assumptions because the inputs provide no expected outputs. Source has not been executed.
